decks.notes: This aggro deck focuses on efficiently casting powerful creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It utilizes a diverse range of colors to access a variety of threats and disruption. The deck aims to apply pressure from the early game with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, while also leveraging powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to control the board. Additionally, Leyline of the Guildpact and Scion of Draco provide additional support and synergy to ensure a fast and aggressive victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo between Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to generate powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy involves ramping up quickly with Eldrazi Temple and Grove of the Burnwillows to cast threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Devourer of Destiny. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command to control the battlefield. With the right pieces in place, this deck can quickly snowball out of control and dominate the game.

The main focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. The deck aims to efficiently control the board through cards like Counterspell, Fatal Push, and Thoughtseize while generating card advantage with Snapcaster Mage and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck also includes card draw and selection options like Cling to Dust and Psychic Frog to help maintain control throughout the game. Overall, the deck's key strategy is to control the game's pace and dictate the flow of the match.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The deck aims to apply early pressure with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while also disrupting opponents with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Galvanic Discharge. The deck also has a strong late-game presence with powerful threats like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional versatility and closing power, making it a versatile and powerful aggro deck in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on utilizing control spells and removal to dominate the game, while also incorporating powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to finish off opponents. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and outvalue them with efficient spell interactions. Key elements include efficient counter spells like Spell Snare and Counterspell, along with removal options such as Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck also features card advantage engines like Cling to Dust and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to maintain resources throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of aggressive creatures and cards that can blink or flicker them in and out of play. By blinking creatures like Emperor of Bones or Ketramose, the New Dawn, the deck can gain value by reusing their enter-the-battlefield abilities. Cards like Solitude and Flickerwisp can provide removal or disruption while also benefiting from the blinking strategy. Thoughtseize and Relic of Progenitus help control the opponent's hand and graveyard, while Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Witch Enchanter offer additional synergies with the deck's theme.

This deck focuses on generating value through a combination of sacrificing and recurring creatures, utilizing cards like Gravecrawler, Bloodghast, and Marionette Apprentice. It also aims to dig through the deck quickly with cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Dredger's Insight to find key combo pieces like Warren Soultrader and Malevolent Rumble. The deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with a swarm of creatures and efficient removal spells like Fatal Push. The strategy revolves around setting up a powerful board state and disrupting the opponent's plans while executing a lethal combo.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Control - UrzaTron deck is to utilize the Urza lands (Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine) to generate significant amounts of mana, allowing for the quick deployment of powerful threats such as Emrakul, the Promised End and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck aims to control the board through cards like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Command, while also being able to search for key pieces with Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying. This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and overwhelming the opponent with massive Eldrazi creatures.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Ocelot Pride and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, the deck seeks to apply pressure early and maintain control of the battlefield. With cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment offering direct damage, the deck aims to close out the game swiftly before the opponent can mount an effective defense.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a significant amount of mana quickly. It then utilizes powerful Eldrazi creatures and spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Kozilek's Command and Thought-Knot Seer to disrupt the opponent's hand and gain an advantage. With access to powerful threats like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, this deck aims to overpower the opponent and control the game until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble and exploit artifacts to generate large amounts of mana and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. The deck utilizes cards that can generate additional artifact tokens, while also including cards that can manipulate the top of the library and provide card advantage. By combining artifact synergy with aggressive creatures and burn spells, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing poison counters to the opponent by using infect creatures and pump spells. The key strategy is to protect your creatures with counterspells like Spell Pierce and pump them up with cards like Scale Up and Might of Old Krosa to deal lethal poison damage in a single turn. The mana base is tuned for consistency and speed, with lands like Inkmoth Nexus and Vines of Vastwood providing additional utility. The inclusion of Phyrexian Crusader adds resilience against removal spells, making it a formidable threat in the format.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, while also utilizing synergies like sacrificing tokens to Goblin Bombardment or utilizing Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for additional advantage. The deck aims to apply pressure early on with efficient creatures like Ragavan and Guide of Souls, while also having control elements like Thraben Charm and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support and buffs to the creature army, creating a fast and impactful aggressive strategy in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck revolves around using rituals and mana accelerants to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing the player to cast multiple spells in a single turn. The deck then aims to draw and cast Glimpse the Impossible to create a storm count, resulting in a lethal Grapeshot or Artist's Talent to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames provides additional sources of card advantage and recursion. The deck aims to win quickly and efficiently through explosive combo turns.

The key strategy of this deck is to use a combination of creatures, artifacts, and spells to generate powerful token creatures with the ability to grow in size and power rapidly. By utilizing cards like Basking Broodscale, Glaring Fleshraker, and Blade of the Bloodchief, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a large army of creatures. Additionally, the inclusion of Eldrazi Temple and Emrakul, the Promised End provides a late-game threat that can quickly close out the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Malevolent Rumble and Soul-Guide Lantern to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with cards that allow them to repeatedly enter the battlefield or protect them from removal. By utilizing flicker effects like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, along with powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, the deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The combination of aggro creatures and blink effects creates a versatile and resilient strategy that can overwhelm opponents quickly.
